notes.title: 1.1.1 Update
notes.content: We have fixed an issue where the respawn time for the hero Lyla was calculated incorrectly, which in some cases caused abnormal respawn time behavior.

notes.title: 1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
1. Reduce minecart damage to allies and increase damage to zombies.
2. Decrease the firing rate of bullet traps but increase their per-shot damage.
3. Lower the difficulty to unlock new units.
4. Significantly buff the damage of suicide Demolitionist.
5. Slightly increase the Tesla Trooper's pulling force.
6. Change Commander Lyla's starting ability to "Field Medic."
7. Nerf Commander Hawk’s explosion radius.
8. Reduce enemy HP in the first level.

notes.title: 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Bugfix[/h3]
1. Fix achievement unlock logic. (Versatile Commander\Specialized Squad)
2. Fix skill description of Shield Generator

notes.title: 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Balance: [/h3]
1. Commander Lyla has been added the Combat Medic skill: Heals the unit with the lowest HP.
2. Commander Lyla’s default skill has been changed to: Increases revival speed for the entire team.
3. Commander Hawk’s HP regeneration rate adjusted from 8 to 5.
4. Commander Dane’s HP regeneration rate adjusted from 8 to 10.

[h3]Technical:[/h3]
1. Fixed a bug where Steam achievements could not be unlocked under certain circumstances.

notes.title: 0.4.12-update
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug with the difficulty display on the results/summary screen. 
[*] Fixed a bug where maps could not be unlocked properly.
[*] Added death sound effect for self-destructing/exploding enemies.
[*] Optimized the colors/color palette for the first level/stage.
[/olist]

notes.title: "Red Cap Squad: Zombie Source" Playtest is open!
notes.content:
Hey Survivors! We're glad to announce that sign-ups for "Red Cap Squad: Zombie Source" are now officially open!

[h3]Why a Playtest?[/h3]
We're running this Playtest to gather invaluable feedback from our early players. Your gameplay experience, any bugs you encounter, and thoughts on game balance will directly help us refine the core mechanics, optimize performance, and shape the game into the best possible version before its official launch.

[h3]What to Expect in this Playtest:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Experience the core combat loop and survival mechanics.
[*]Try out all characters and their unique skills.
[*]Explore the roguelike progression system.
[*]Please Note: This is not the final version. You may encounter bugs, unfinished features, or areas needing balance adjustments.
[/list]
[h3]How to Join:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Visit the "Red Cap Squad: Zombie Source" Steam Store page.
[*] Look for the Playtest section and click the "Request Access" button.
[/olist]
[h3]Providing Feedback:[/h3]
We're eager to hear your thoughts! Please share your feedback, suggestions, and bug reports through:
[list]
[*] Steam Community Hub: https://steamcommunity.com/app/3340120/discussions/
[*] Official Discord Server: https://discord.gg/puGpMjAVNZ
[/list]
[h3]Playtest Duration:[/h3]
This Playtest is planned to run till 10th April. The offical version will release on Steam on April 11th.


Thank you for your interest and support! Are you ready to join the Red Cap Squad and face the bloodbath against the zombie tide? Request access today!
Happy Gaming!

-- Long Hu Studio
